The two original tails share their actual gcd with the fixed right tail.
All factors and unit gates are derived by applying the original root packet
twice. The difference k is signed, the root has its original negative sign,
and the complete slow phase has denominator N1*K*t*t'. Modulus one is allowed.

The separate real-projection identity retains all four complex branches,
including their original amplitudes and coefficients. No finite carrier is
changed and no spectral estimate, (y,z) reindexing, or 7/32 bound is asserted.
The imported root-packet source is still a candidate pending root acceptance.
-/

private theorem inverse_pair_modEq {m n t t' : ℕ}
    (hn : n.Coprime m) (ht : t.Coprime m) (ht' : t'.Coprime m)
    (h h' : ℤ) :
    Int.ModEq m
      (h * CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m -
        h' * CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m)
      ((h * (t' : ℤ) - h' * (t : ℤ)) *
        CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * (t * t')) m) := by
  let x := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m
  let x' := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m
  let j := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * (t * t')) m
  have hx : Int.ModEq m (((n * t : ℕ) : ℤ) * x) 1 :=
    CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse_spec (hn.mul_left ht)
  have hx' : Int.ModEq m (((n * t' : ℕ) : ℤ) * x') 1 :=
    CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse_spec (hn.mul_left ht')
  have hj : Int.ModEq m (((n * (t * t') : ℕ) : ℤ) * j) 1 :=
    CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse_spec (hn.mul_left (ht.mul_left ht'))
  have hleft : Int.ModEq m x ((t' : ℤ) * j) := by
    calc
      x ≡ x * (((n * (t * t') : ℕ) : ℤ) * j) [ZMOD m] := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using (hj.mul_left x).symm
      _ = ((t' : ℤ) * j) * (((n * t : ℕ) : ℤ) * x) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ ≡ (t' : ℤ) * j [ZMOD m] := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using hx.mul_left ((t' : ℤ) * j)
  have hright : Int.ModEq m x' ((t : ℤ) * j) := by
    calc
      x' ≡ x' * (((n * (t * t') : ℕ) : ℤ) * j) [ZMOD m] := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using (hj.mul_left x').symm
      _ = ((t : ℤ) * j) * (((n * t' : ℕ) : ℤ) * x') := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ ≡ (t : ℤ) * j [ZMOD m] := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using hx'.mul_left ((t : ℤ) * j)
  have hdifference := (hleft.mul_left h).sub (hright.mul_left h')
  convert hdifference using 1 <;> ring

private theorem fourier_pair_real (h h' : ℤ) (x x' : ℝ) :
    fourier h (x : UnitAddCircle) * star (fourier h' (x' : UnitAddCircle)) =
      fourier 1 ((((h : ℝ) * x - (h' : ℝ) * x') : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) := by
  simp only [Complex.star_def]
  rw [← fourier_neg]
  simp only [fourier_coe_apply, div_one]
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

private theorem inverse_fourier_pair {m n t t' : ℕ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hn : n.Coprime m)
    (ht : t.Coprime m) (ht' : t'.Coprime m) (a h h' : ℤ) :
    fourier h
        ((((a : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m : ℝ) / m) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) *
      star (fourier h'
        ((((a : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m : ℝ) / m) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle)) =
      fourier 1
        ((((a : ℝ) * ((h * (t' : ℤ) - h' * (t : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * (t * t')) m : ℝ) / m) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) := by
  have hcircle := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhase_circle_eq_of_modEq hm
    ((inverse_pair_modEq hn ht ht' h h').mul_left a)
  rw [fourier_pair_real]
  have hreal :
      (h : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m : ℝ) / m) -
      (h' : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m : ℝ) / m) =
      ((a * (h * CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m -
        h' * CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m) : ℤ) : ℝ) / m := by
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hreal]
  simpa only [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_sub, mul_assoc] using
    congrArg (fourier 1) hcircle

/-- The actual pair of CRT phases on the same original general-D row.
Only original positivity, two original CRT branches and equality of the two
actual gcds are premises. No packet factors, units or phase identities are
provided by a caller. The original signed frequencies and full slow phase
survive, before any real projection or finite regrouping. -/
theorem sharedGeneralD_paired_fourier
    {p r s s' w N1 N2 : ℕ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (hs' : 0 < s') (hw : 0 < w)
    (hN1 : 0 < N1) (hN2 : 0 < N2)
    (hc : ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2)
    (hc' : ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (r * s')) (p * w) N1 N2)
    (hsame : (r * s').gcd w = (r * s).gcd w) (a h h' : ℤ) :
    let D := (r * s).gcd w
    let d := r.gcd D
    let q := D / d
    let r0 := r / d
    let t := s / q
    let t' := s' / q
    let g := N1.gcd N2
    let d1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart (N1 / g) g
    let n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N1 / g) g
    let n2 := N2 / g
    let A := g * d1
    let w0 := w / D
    let b := A * n2 * r0
    let c := n1 * w0
    let zeta := c * p * D * r0
    let K := (p * D) * r0 * w0
    let L := (p * (r * s)).lcm (p * w)
    let L' := (p * (r * s')).lcm (p * w)
    let f : ℤ := ((d1 : ℤ) * n1 - n2) / (p * D : ℕ)
    let k : ℤ := h * (t' : ℤ) - h' * (t : ℤ)
    let z := t * t'
    0 < K ∧ 0 < A ∧ 0 < c ∧
      s = q * t ∧ s' = q * t' ∧
      b.Coprime c ∧ zeta.Coprime A ∧
      t.Coprime (A * c) ∧ t'.Coprime (A * c) ∧
      L = K * t ∧ L' = K * t' ∧
      fourier h
        (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h'
          (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s')) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L' : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle)) =
        fourier 1
          (((-(a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) *
            (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * z) A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
              UnitAddCircle) *
          fourier 1 ((((a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) /
            ((N1 : ℝ) * K * z)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
          fourier 1
            ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) *
              (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * z) c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
                UnitAddCircle) := by
  let D := (r * s).gcd w
  let d := r.gcd D
  let q := D / d
  let r0 := r / d
  let t := s / q
  let t' := s' / q
  let g := N1.gcd N2
  let d1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart (N1 / g) g
  let n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N1 / g) g
  let n2 := N2 / g
  let A := g * d1
  let w0 := w / D
  let b := A * n2 * r0
  let c := n1 * w0
  let zeta := c * p * D * r0
  let K := (p * D) * r0 * w0
  let L := (p * (r * s)).lcm (p * w)
  let L' := (p * (r * s')).lcm (p * w)
  let f : ℤ := ((d1 : ℤ) * n1 - n2) / (p * D : ℕ)
  let k : ℤ := h * (t' : ℤ) - h' * (t : ℤ)
  let z := t * t'
  have hdata := sharedGeneralDRootPacket_fourier hp hr hs hw hN1 hN2 hc a h
  have hdata' := sharedGeneralDRootPacket_fourier hp hr hs' hw hN1 hN2 hc' a h'
  dsimp only at hdata hdata'
  rw [hsame] at hdata'
  obtain ⟨_hq, hr0, ht, hA, hcpos, hst, _hvt, _hrq,
    hb, hzeta, htAc, hroot, _hrecip, hphase⟩ := hdata
  obtain ⟨_hq', _hr0', ht', _hA', _hcpos', hst', _hvt', _hrq',
    _hb', _hzeta', htAc', hroot', _hrecip', hphase'⟩ := hdata'
  change 0 < r0 at hr0
  change 0 < t at ht
  change 0 < t' at ht'
  change 0 < A at hA
  change 0 < c at hcpos
  change s = q * t at hst
  change s' = q * t' at hst'
  change b.Coprime c at hb
  change zeta.Coprime A at hzeta
  change t.Coprime (A * c) at htAc
  change t'.Coprime (A * c) at htAc'
  change n1 * L = zeta * t at hroot
  change n1 * L' = zeta * t' at hroot'
  have hn1 : 0 < n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart_pos _ _
  have hL : L = K * t := by
    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel hn1
    calc
      n1 * L = zeta * t := hroot
      _ = n1 * (K * t) := by dsimp only [zeta, c, K]; ring
  have hL' : L' = K * t' := by
    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel hn1
    calc
      n1 * L' = zeta * t' := hroot'
      _ = n1 * (K * t') := by dsimp only [zeta, c, K]; ring
  have hD : 0 < D := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left w (Nat.mul_pos hr hs)
  have hw0 : 0 < w0 :=
    Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hw (Nat.gcd_dvd_right (r * s) w)) hD
  have hK : 0 < K := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos hp hD) hr0) hw0
  have htA : t.Coprime A := htAc.of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_right A c)
  have htA' : t'.Coprime A := htAc'.of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_right A c)
  have htc : t.Coprime c := htAc.of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_left c A)
  have htc' : t'.Coprime c := htAc'.of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_left c A)
  change fourier h
      (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L : ℝ) :
        UnitAddCircle) =
      fourier h (((-(a : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * t) A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * t) c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) at hphase
  change fourier h'
      (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s')) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L' : ℝ) :
        UnitAddCircle) =
      fourier h' (((-(a : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * t') A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L')) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * t') c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) at hphase'
  have hrootpair := SharedGeneralDPairedFourier.inverse_fourier_pair
    hA hzeta htA htA' (-a) h h'
  have hrecippair := SharedGeneralDPairedFourier.inverse_fourier_pair
    hcpos hb htc htc' (a * f) h h'
  simp only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_mul, mul_assoc] at hrootpair hrecippair
  have hslowpair :
      fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L')) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) =
      fourier 1 ((((a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) /
        ((N1 : ℝ) * K * z)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) := by
    rw [SharedGeneralDPairedFourier.fourier_pair_real]
    have hreal :
        (h : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) -
          (h' : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L')) =
        (a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * K * z) := by
      rw [hL, hL']
      dsimp only [k, z]
      push_cast
      have hN10 : (N1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hK0 : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have ht'0 : (t' : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hN10, hK0, ht0, ht'0] <;> ring
    rw [hreal]
  refine ⟨hK, hA, hcpos, hst, hst', hb, hzeta, htAc, htAc', hL, hL', ?_⟩
  rw [hphase, hphase']
  simp only [star_mul]
  calc
    _ =
      (fourier h (((-(a : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * t) A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h' (((-(a : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * t') A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle))) *
      (fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L')) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle))) *
      (fourier h ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * t) c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * t') c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle))) := by ring
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [k, z, mul_assoc] using
        congrArg₂ (fun x y : ℂ => x * y)
          (congrArg₂ (fun x y : ℂ => x * y) hrootpair hslowpair) hrecippair

/-- Apply this to the complete smooth Fourier atoms F,G, including their
low pass and Poisson amplitudes. It is the exact real-projection Gram,
with all four branches and arbitrary original complex coefficients. -/
theorem sharedGeneralD_realProjection_four_branches (lambda mu F G : ℂ) :
    (lambda * (F.re : ℂ)) * star (mu * (G.re : ℂ)) =
      (lambda * star mu) / 4 *
        (F * star G + F * G + star F * star G + star F * G) := by
  simp only [star_mul, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  rw [Complex.re_eq_add_conj F, Complex.re_eq_add_conj G]
  ring

end

private theorem inverse_pair_modEq {m n t t' : ℕ}
    (hn : n.Coprime m) (ht : t.Coprime m) (ht' : t'.Coprime m)
    (h h' : ℤ) :
    Int.ModEq m
      (h * CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m -
        h' * CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m)
      ((h * (t' : ℤ) - h' * (t : ℤ)) *
        CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * (t * t')) m) := by
  let x := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m
  let x' := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m
  let j := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * (t * t')) m
  have hx : Int.ModEq m (((n * t : ℕ) : ℤ) * x) 1 :=
    CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse_spec (hn.mul_left ht)
  have hx' : Int.ModEq m (((n * t' : ℕ) : ℤ) * x') 1 :=
    CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse_spec (hn.mul_left ht')
  have hj : Int.ModEq m (((n * (t * t') : ℕ) : ℤ) * j) 1 :=
    CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse_spec (hn.mul_left (ht.mul_left ht'))
  have hleft : Int.ModEq m x ((t' : ℤ) * j) := by
    calc
      x ≡ x * (((n * (t * t') : ℕ) : ℤ) * j) [ZMOD m] := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using (hj.mul_left x).symm
      _ = ((t' : ℤ) * j) * (((n * t : ℕ) : ℤ) * x) := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ ≡ (t' : ℤ) * j [ZMOD m] := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using hx.mul_left ((t' : ℤ) * j)
  have hright : Int.ModEq m x' ((t : ℤ) * j) := by
    calc
      x' ≡ x' * (((n * (t * t') : ℕ) : ℤ) * j) [ZMOD m] := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using (hj.mul_left x').symm
      _ = ((t : ℤ) * j) * (((n * t' : ℕ) : ℤ) * x') := by
        push_cast
        ring
      _ ≡ (t : ℤ) * j [ZMOD m] := by
        simpa only [mul_one] using hx'.mul_left ((t : ℤ) * j)
  have hdifference := (hleft.mul_left h).sub (hright.mul_left h')
  convert hdifference using 1 <;> ring

private theorem fourier_pair_real (h h' : ℤ) (x x' : ℝ) :
    fourier h (x : UnitAddCircle) * star (fourier h' (x' : UnitAddCircle)) =
      fourier 1 ((((h : ℝ) * x - (h' : ℝ) * x') : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) := by
  simp only [Complex.star_def]
  rw [← fourier_neg]
  simp only [fourier_coe_apply, div_one]
  rw [← Complex.exp_add]
  congr 1
  push_cast
  ring

private theorem inverse_fourier_pair {m n t t' : ℕ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hn : n.Coprime m)
    (ht : t.Coprime m) (ht' : t'.Coprime m) (a h h' : ℤ) :
    fourier h
        ((((a : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m : ℝ) / m) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) *
      star (fourier h'
        ((((a : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m : ℝ) / m) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle)) =
      fourier 1
        ((((a : ℝ) * ((h * (t' : ℤ) - h' * (t : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * (t * t')) m : ℝ) / m) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) := by
  have hcircle := CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhase_circle_eq_of_modEq hm
    ((inverse_pair_modEq hn ht ht' h h').mul_left a)
  rw [fourier_pair_real]
  have hreal :
      (h : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m : ℝ) / m) -
      (h' : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m : ℝ) / m) =
      ((a * (h * CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t) m -
        h' * CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n * t') m) : ℤ) : ℝ) / m := by
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hreal]
  simpa only [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_sub, mul_assoc] using
    congrArg (fourier 1) hcircle

end SharedGeneralDPairedFourier

/-- The actual pair of CRT phases on the same original general-D row.
Only original positivity, two original CRT branches and equality of the two
actual gcds are premises. No packet factors, units or phase identities are
provided by a caller. The original signed frequencies and full slow phase
survive, before any real projection or finite regrouping. -/
theorem sharedGeneralD_paired_fourier
    {p r s s' w N1 N2 : ℕ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (hs' : 0 < s') (hw : 0 < w)
    (hN1 : 0 < N1) (hN2 : 0 < N2)
    (hc : ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2)
    (hc' : ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (r * s')) (p * w) N1 N2)
    (hsame : (r * s').gcd w = (r * s).gcd w) (a h h' : ℤ) :
    let D := (r * s).gcd w
    let d := r.gcd D
    let q := D / d
    let r0 := r / d
    let t := s / q
    let t' := s' / q
    let g := N1.gcd N2
    let d1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart (N1 / g) g
    let n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N1 / g) g
    let n2 := N2 / g
    let A := g * d1
    let w0 := w / D
    let b := A * n2 * r0
    let c := n1 * w0
    let zeta := c * p * D * r0
    let K := (p * D) * r0 * w0
    let L := (p * (r * s)).lcm (p * w)
    let L' := (p * (r * s')).lcm (p * w)
    let f : ℤ := ((d1 : ℤ) * n1 - n2) / (p * D : ℕ)
    let k : ℤ := h * (t' : ℤ) - h' * (t : ℤ)
    let z := t * t'
    0 < K ∧ 0 < A ∧ 0 < c ∧
      s = q * t ∧ s' = q * t' ∧
      b.Coprime c ∧ zeta.Coprime A ∧
      t.Coprime (A * c) ∧ t'.Coprime (A * c) ∧
      L = K * t ∧ L' = K * t' ∧
      fourier h
        (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h'
          (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s')) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L' : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle)) =
        fourier 1
          (((-(a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) *
            (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * z) A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
              UnitAddCircle) *
          fourier 1 ((((a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) /
            ((N1 : ℝ) * K * z)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
          fourier 1
            ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) *
              (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * z) c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
                UnitAddCircle) := by
  let D := (r * s).gcd w
  let d := r.gcd D
  let q := D / d
  let r0 := r / d
  let t := s / q
  let t' := s' / q
  let g := N1.gcd N2
  let d1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart (N1 / g) g
  let n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N1 / g) g
  let n2 := N2 / g
  let A := g * d1
  let w0 := w / D
  let b := A * n2 * r0
  let c := n1 * w0
  let zeta := c * p * D * r0
  let K := (p * D) * r0 * w0
  let L := (p * (r * s)).lcm (p * w)
  let L' := (p * (r * s')).lcm (p * w)
  let f : ℤ := ((d1 : ℤ) * n1 - n2) / (p * D : ℕ)
  let k : ℤ := h * (t' : ℤ) - h' * (t : ℤ)
  let z := t * t'
  have hdata := sharedGeneralDRootPacket_fourier hp hr hs hw hN1 hN2 hc a h
  have hdata' := sharedGeneralDRootPacket_fourier hp hr hs' hw hN1 hN2 hc' a h'
  dsimp only at hdata hdata'
  rw [hsame] at hdata'
  obtain ⟨_hq, hr0, ht, hA, hcpos, hst, _hvt, _hrq,
    hb, hzeta, htAc, hroot, _hrecip, hphase⟩ := hdata
  obtain ⟨_hq', _hr0', ht', _hA', _hcpos', hst', _hvt', _hrq',
    _hb', _hzeta', htAc', hroot', _hrecip', hphase'⟩ := hdata'
  change 0 < r0 at hr0
  change 0 < t at ht
  change 0 < t' at ht'
  change 0 < A at hA
  change 0 < c at hcpos
  change s = q * t at hst
  change s' = q * t' at hst'
  change b.Coprime c at hb
  change zeta.Coprime A at hzeta
  change t.Coprime (A * c) at htAc
  change t'.Coprime (A * c) at htAc'
  change n1 * L = zeta * t at hroot
  change n1 * L' = zeta * t' at hroot'
  have hn1 : 0 < n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart_pos _ _
  have hL : L = K * t := by
    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel hn1
    calc
      n1 * L = zeta * t := hroot
      _ = n1 * (K * t) := by dsimp only [zeta, c, K]; ring
  have hL' : L' = K * t' := by
    apply Nat.mul_left_cancel hn1
    calc
      n1 * L' = zeta * t' := hroot'
      _ = n1 * (K * t') := by dsimp only [zeta, c, K]; ring
  have hD : 0 < D := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left w (Nat.mul_pos hr hs)
  have hw0 : 0 < w0 :=
    Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hw (Nat.gcd_dvd_right (r * s) w)) hD
  have hK : 0 < K := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos hp hD) hr0) hw0
  have htA : t.Coprime A := htAc.of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_right A c)
  have htA' : t'.Coprime A := htAc'.of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_right A c)
  have htc : t.Coprime c := htAc.of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_left c A)
  have htc' : t'.Coprime c := htAc'.of_dvd_right (dvd_mul_left c A)
  change fourier h
      (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L : ℝ) :
        UnitAddCircle) =
      fourier h (((-(a : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * t) A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * t) c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) at hphase
  change fourier h'
      (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s')) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L' : ℝ) :
        UnitAddCircle) =
      fourier h' (((-(a : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * t') A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L')) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * t') c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) at hphase'
  have hrootpair := SharedGeneralDPairedFourier.inverse_fourier_pair
    hA hzeta htA htA' (-a) h h'
  have hrecippair := SharedGeneralDPairedFourier.inverse_fourier_pair
    hcpos hb htc htc' (a * f) h h'
  simp only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_mul, mul_assoc] at hrootpair hrecippair
  have hslowpair :
      fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L')) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle)) =
      fourier 1 ((((a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) /
        ((N1 : ℝ) * K * z)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) := by
    rw [SharedGeneralDPairedFourier.fourier_pair_real]
    have hreal :
        (h : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) -
          (h' : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L')) =
        (a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * K * z) := by
      rw [hL, hL']
      dsimp only [k, z]
      push_cast
      have hN10 : (N1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have hK0 : (K : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have ht'0 : (t' : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp [hN10, hK0, ht0, ht'0] <;> ring
    rw [hreal]
  refine ⟨hK, hA, hcpos, hst, hst', hb, hzeta, htAc, htAc', hL, hL', ?_⟩
  rw [hphase, hphase']
  simp only [star_mul]
  calc
    _ =
      (fourier h (((-(a : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * t) A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h' (((-(a : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * t') A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle))) *
      (fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L')) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle))) *
      (fourier h ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * t) c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) *
        star (fourier h' ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * t') c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle))) := by ring
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [k, z, mul_assoc] using
        congrArg₂ (fun x y : ℂ => x * y)
          (congrArg₂ (fun x y : ℂ => x * y) hrootpair hslowpair) hrecippair

/-- Apply this to the complete smooth Fourier atoms F,G, including their
low pass and Poisson amplitudes. It is the exact real-projection Gram,
with all four branches and arbitrary original complex coefficients. -/
theorem sharedGeneralD_realProjection_four_branches (lambda mu F G : ℂ) :
    (lambda * (F.re : ℂ)) * star (mu * (G.re : ℂ)) =
      (lambda * star mu) / 4 *
        (F * star G + F * G + star F * star G + star F * G) := by
  simp only [star_mul, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  rw [Complex.re_eq_add_conj F, Complex.re_eq_add_conj G]
  ring

end

private theorem normalized_tail {r s w : ℕ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) :
    let D := (r * s).gcd w
    let d := r.gcd D
    let q := D / d
    let r0 := r / d
    let t := s / q
    0 < q ∧ 0 < r0 ∧ 0 < t ∧ r0.Coprime q ∧
      s = q * t ∧ (r * s) / D = r0 * t := by
  let D := (r * s).gcd w
  let d := r.gcd D
  let q := D / d
  let r0 := r / d
  let t := s / q
  change 0 < q ∧ 0 < r0 ∧ 0 < t ∧ r0.Coprime q ∧
    s = q * t ∧ (r * s) / D = r0 * t
  have hD : 0 < D := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left w (Nat.mul_pos hr hs)
  have hd : 0 < d := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left D hr
  have hdD : d ∣ D := Nat.gcd_dvd_right r D
  have hdr : d ∣ r := Nat.gcd_dvd_left r D
  have hDdiv : D ∣ r * s := Nat.gcd_dvd_left (r * s) w
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hD hdD) hd
  have hr0 : 0 < r0 := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hr hdr) hd
  have hDfact : d * q = D := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdD
  have hrfact : d * r0 = r := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdr
  have hcop : r0.Coprime q := Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd hd
  have hqdiv : q ∣ r0 * s := by
    apply Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left hd
    simpa only [← mul_assoc, hDfact, hrfact] using hDdiv
  have hqs : q ∣ s := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hqdiv
  have hsfact : q * t = s := Nat.mul_div_cancel' hqs
  have ht : 0 < t := Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd hs hqs) hq
  refine ⟨hq, hr0, ht, hcop, hsfact.symm, ?_⟩
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel hD
  rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' hDdiv]
  calc
    r * s = (d * r0) * (q * t) := by rw [hrfact, hsfact]
    _ = D * (r0 * t) := by rw [← hDfact]; ring

theorem sharedGeneralDRootPacket_fourier
    {p r s w N1 N2 : ℕ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (hw : 0 < w)

    (hc : ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2)

    let n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N1 / g) g
    let n2 := N2 / g
    let A := g * d1
    let w0 := w / D
    let b := A * n2 * r0
    let c := n1 * w0
    let zeta := c * p * D * r0
    let L := (p * (r * s)).lcm (p * w)
    let f : ℤ := ((d1 : ℤ) * n1 - n2) / (p * D : ℕ)
    0 < q ∧ 0 < r0 ∧ 0 < t ∧ 0 < A ∧ 0 < c ∧
      s = q * t ∧ (r * s) / D = r0 * t ∧ r0.Coprime q ∧
      b.Coprime c ∧ zeta.Coprime A ∧ t.Coprime (A * c) ∧
      n1 * L = zeta * t ∧ A * n2 * ((r * s) / D) = b * t ∧
      fourier h
        (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle) =
        fourier h
          (((-(a : ℝ) *
            (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * t) A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
              UnitAddCircle) *
          fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
          fourier h
            (((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
              (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * t) c : ℝ)) / c) : ℝ) :
                UnitAddCircle) := by
  let D := (r * s).gcd w
  let d := r.gcd D
  let q := D / d
  let r0 := r / d
  let t := s / q
  let g := N1.gcd N2
  let d1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart (N1 / g) g
  let n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N1 / g) g
  let n2 := N2 / g
  let A := g * d1
  let w0 := w / D
  let b := A * n2 * r0
  let c := n1 * w0
  let zeta := c * p * D * r0
  let L := (p * (r * s)).lcm (p * w)
  let f : ℤ := ((d1 : ℤ) * n1 - n2) / (p * D : ℕ)
  obtain ⟨hq, hr0, ht, hrq, hst, hvt⟩ :=
    SharedGeneralDRootPacket.normalized_tail (w := w) hr hs
  change 0 < q at hq
  change 0 < r0 at hr0
  change 0 < t at ht
  change r0.Coprime q at hrq
  change s = q * t at hst
  change (r * s) / D = r0 * t at hvt
  have hlic := sharedDifferenceData_licenses hp (Nat.mul_pos hr hs) hw hN1 hN2 hc a
  dsimp only at hlic
  obtain ⟨_hg, _hD, _hd1, hn1, _hn2, _hv0, hw0, hA, _hL,
    _hN1eq, _hN2eq, _hv_eq, _hw_eq, hLeq, _hvw, _hnD, _hvc,
    hbc, hroot, _rest⟩ := hlic
  change 0 < n1 at hn1
  change 0 < w0 at hw0
  change 0 < A at hA
  change L = (p * D) * ((r * s) / D) * w0 at hLeq
  change (A * n2 * ((r * s) / D)).Coprime c at hbc
  change (n1 * L).Coprime A at hroot
  have hrecip : A * n2 * ((r * s) / D) = b * t := by
    rw [hvt]
    dsimp only [b]
    ring
  have hrootden : n1 * L = zeta * t := by
    rw [hLeq, hvt]
    dsimp only [zeta, c]
    ring
  rw [hrecip] at hbc
  rw [hrootden] at hroot
  have h_b : b.Coprime c := hbc.of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_right b t)
  have h_tc : t.Coprime c := hbc.of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_left t b)
  have h_zeta : zeta.Coprime A := hroot.of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_right zeta t)
  have h_tA : t.Coprime A := hroot.of_dvd_left (dvd_mul_left t zeta)
  refine ⟨hq, hr0, ht, hA, Nat.mul_pos hn1 hw0, hst, hvt, hrq,
    h_b, h_zeta, h_tA.mul_right h_tc, hrootden, hrecip, ?_⟩
  have he := sharedDifferenceReciprocity_fourier hp (Nat.mul_pos hr hs) hw hN1 hN2 hc a h
  change fourier h
      (((ComplexCRT.residue (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2 a : ℝ) / L : ℝ) :
        UnitAddCircle) =
      fourier h
        (((-(a : ℝ) *
          (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (n1 * L) A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
            UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h ((((a : ℝ) / ((N1 : ℝ) * L)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
        fourier h
          (((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) *
            (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse
              (A * n2 * ((r * s) / D)) c : ℝ)) / ((n1 : ℝ) * w0)) : ℝ) :
              UnitAddCircle) at he
  have hcR : (c : ℝ) = (n1 : ℝ) * w0 := Nat.cast_mul n1 w0
  simpa only [hrootden, hrecip, hcR] using he

theorem wPhaseInverse_spec {n m : ℕ} (h : n.Coprime m) :

  refine ⟨n.gcdB m, ?_⟩
  have hb := Nat.gcd_eq_gcd_ab n m
  rw [h.gcd_eq_one, Nat.cast_one] at hb
  dsimp [wPhaseInverse]
  linarith

    (((x : ℝ) / m : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) = ((y : ℝ) / m : ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h.dvd
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← AddCircle.coe_sub, AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨-z, ?_⟩

  have hz' : (y : ℝ) - x = m * (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hz
  simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_neg, mul_one]
  field_simp
  nlinarith

/-- The complementary factor of `n`, containing primes not dividing `d`. -/
def coprimePart (n d : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun p => ¬p ∣ d), p ^ n.factorization p

theorem supportedPart_pos (n d : ℕ) : 0 < supportedPart n d := by
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro p hp
  exact pow_ne_zero _ (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1).ne_zero

theorem coprimePart_pos (n d : ℕ) : 0 < coprimePart n d := by
  apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro p hp
  exact pow_ne_zero _ (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1).ne_zero

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredOuterCarrier (d : MediumAtom) :
    Finset ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) :=
  let Pairs := (d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ
    (d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier ×ˢ d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier)).filter
      (fun t => t.2.1 ≠ t.2.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
  let Tails := (factorCarrier d.Q3) ×ˢ
    ((factorCarrier d.Q3) ×ˢ factorCarrier d.Q2)
  Pairs ×ˢ Tails.biUnion (fun t =>
    (t.2.1 * t.2.2).divisors.image (fun D => (t, D)))

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) : Finset (ℕ × ℤ) :=
  factorCarrier d.Q2 ×ˢ
    CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequencyWindow
      (d.sharedSmoothFrequencyBound Z o.2.2)

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredRowTerm (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) (u : ℕ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  let p := o.1.1
  let N1 := o.1.2.1
  let N2 := o.1.2.2
  let v := o.2.1.1 * u.1
  let w := o.2.1.2.1 * o.2.1.2.2
  let D := o.2.2
  let q := p * v
  let q' := p * w
  let L := q.lcm q'
  if v.gcd w = D ∧ ComplexCRT.Compatible q q' N1 N2 then
    d.gamma2 u.1 *
      (((CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonSmoothLowPass
          ((d.V / (L : ℝ)) * (u.2 : ℝ) / Z) : ℂ) *
        CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequency (d.V / (L : ℝ))
          ((ComplexCRT.residue q q' N1 N2 d.residue : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) u.2).re : ℂ)
  else 0

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredOuterCoefficient (d : MediumAtom)
    (Ybeta Ysupport : ℝ)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) : ℂ :=
  let N1 := o.1.2.1
  let N2 := o.1.2.2
  if (N1.gcd N2 : ℝ) ≤ Ybeta ∧
      (CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart
        (N1 / N1.gcd N2) (N1.gcd N2) : ℝ) ≤ Ysupport then
    d.transposedAtom.beta N1 * star (d.transposedAtom.beta N2) *
      d.gamma3 o.2.1.1 * star (d.gamma3 o.2.1.2.1) * star (d.gamma2 o.2.1.2.2)
  else 0

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredBlock (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ)
    (resonant : Bool) (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) : ℂ :=
  ∑ u ∈ d.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier Z o,
    ∑ v ∈ d.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier Z o,
      if decide (u.2 * (v.1 : ℤ) = v.2 * (u.1 : ℤ) ∨
          u.2 * (v.1 : ℤ) = -(v.2 * (u.1 : ℤ))) = resonant then
        d.smallCoreSquaredRowTerm Z o u * star (d.smallCoreSquaredRowTerm Z o v)
      else 0

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredCauchyMass (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ)
    (resonant : Bool) : ℝ :=
  (d.smallCoreSquaredOuterCarrier.card : ℝ) *
    ∑ o ∈ d.smallCoreSquaredOuterCarrier, (d.smallCoreSquaredBlock Z resonant o).re

def Compatible (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : Prop :=
  m1.Coprime q ∧ m2.Coprime r ∧ Nat.ModEq (q.gcd r) m1 m2

theorem residue_spec {q r m1 m2 : ℕ} (a : ℤ) (hc : Compatible q r m1 m2) :
    Int.ModEq q (residue q r m1 m2 a * m1) a ∧
      Int.ModEq r (residue q r m1 m2 a * m2) a ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ, (Int.ModEq q (n * m1) a ∧ Int.ModEq r (n * m2) a) ↔
          Int.ModEq (q.lcm r) n (residue q r m1 m2 a) := by
  simpa only [residue, dif_pos hc] using
    Classical.choose_spec (exists_product_crt_residue hc.1 hc.2.1 hc.2.2 a)

def productProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n ∈ S, if Int.ModEq q ((n : ℤ) * m1) a ∧
    Int.ModEq r ((n : ℤ) * m2) a then w n else 0

def constructedProgressionWeight (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℤ)
    (q r m1 m2 : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  if Compatible q r m1 m2 then
    ∑ n ∈ S, if Int.ModEq (q.lcm r) (n : ℤ) (residue q r m1 m2 a)
      then w n else 0
